method: Original GitHub REST issue bodies and all accessible paginated conversation comments; linked external pages/review threads/invisible history not included. Archive hashes cover canonical sorted-key UTF-8 JSON plus newline. Collection is not semantic review.

records.title: Unnecessary store and reload emitted after shuffle operation is vectorized on Clang on x86 with SSE2
records.review_note: Byte-table loop to PSHUFD retains stack traffic because bitcast/extract SLP fails before SSE4.1; discussion says upstream fixed. Current typed four-dword bridge is not proof of recognizing the byte-table loop.

records.title: [X86] Failure to match PMADDUBSW / VPDPBUSD from shuffled zext*sext pair and quad sums
records.review_note: Dot-product matching from shuffled signed/unsigned widened bytes requires saturation-aware PMADDUBSW/VPDPBUSD recognition. Body only links the reproducer; no local equivalence or coverage inferred.

records.title: [InstCombine] Sparse shuffle+bitcast+shift widening DAG is not folded to sext/zext
records.review_note: Repeated byte/word shuffles plus ASHR24 or LSHR24 express signed/unsigned byte widening; requires width-changing byte provenance. Report's own AArch64 modeled throughput worsens despite fewer instructions.

records.title: [X86][AVX] Expansion of 256 bit vector loads fails to fold into shuffles
records.review_note: Recreating a 32-byte load from two surviving scalar loads needs dereferenceability proof for discarded lanes. Discussion attributes lost proof to InstCombine/Attributor; never widen arbitrary loads just to fold a shuffle.

records.title: [X86] clang emits slowers shuffles with broadcasti128 instrisic than the float equivelent
records.review_note: Integer versus FP broadcast domains select different cross-lane shuffle sequences before later domain conversion; requires AVX lane/domain cost-aware canonicalization.

records.title: [VectorCombine][X86] Failure to replace @llvm.x86.sse41.pblendvb with select
records.review_note: PBLENDVB to generic select requires canonical sign-extended masks through bitcasts and logic; blindly dropping one-use constraints or byte-mask interpretation can regress. New canonical-mask proof is only a bounded register subset, not full blend/bitcast conversion.

records.title: [VectorCombine][X86] Poor handling of compare-select patterns with AVX2 spoofing on AVX1 targets
records.review_note: Fake AVX2 via AVX1 halves needs binary/length-changing shuffle and cast-concat folding with accurate costs; upstream partial changes had regressions. No unconditional width-changing reconstruction.

records.title: [X86] Bad codegen for multiple vector selects with same condition
records.review_note: Two vector selects sharing a scalar condition should share a branch; requires grouped select lowering/CFG and ABI-result analysis, not lane-mask algebra.

records.title: [X86] Failure to fold input shuffle into pclmulqdq instruction
records.review_note: PCLMUL source-half swaps can change immediate 1 to 16, eliminating shuffles. Needs intrinsic-specific lane selectors and private-use/feature checks; no generic permutation motion through carryless multiplication.

records.title: [X86] Fold paired post-mask users of a constant-data PSHUFB into transformed LUT shuffles
records.review_note: Faiss N=1 constant PSHUFB with two post-masks can use two transformed LUTs; zeroing semantics and cross-byte shift mask prove legality, but extra constants/shuffle-port pressure require target costing. N=2/3 sums do not admit the same rewrite.

records.title: [VectorCombine][X86] Allow equal-cost single-use load scalarization to expose further optimizations
records.review_note: Equal-cost single-extract vector-load scalarization narrows [0,16) to [0,4), exposing forwarding past a pointer store [12,20); require single use, nonvolatile and exact access size, with pipeline tests separate from matcher tests.

records.title: [X86][VectorCombine] Missed combination of adjacent equal-type vector stores
records.review_note: Title suggests store combining but current body is CPU-specific VINSERTPS reciprocal-throughput costing. Independent destination avoids RAW latency; conservative integer TTI costs are not measured application speedups.

records.title: [X86] Redundant vpsllw/vpsraw on deep vector mask chains
records.review_note: Seven compare leaves and six Boolean operations lose canonical-mask knowledge at LLVM recursion depth six, adding PSLLW/PSRAW. Candidate bounded canonical-mask proof can remove only explicitly represented redundant shifts, not claim wholesale LLVM legalization behavior.

records.title: [X86] InstCombine change breaks blsic matching
records.review_note: InstCombine canonicalization from x-1 OR ~x to inverted BLSI breaks TBM BLSIC selection. Target-gated alternate matching needed; TBM is not baseline SSE2 and canonical form should not be globally reversed.

records.title: [InstCombine][VectorCombine] "Fold the set of constants by cttz into a product of the lowest set bit" should be cost-driven
records.review_note: Replacing shift-by-CTTZ with isolated-low-bit multiplication is irreversible and can regress Zen5/Apple costs; preserve zero-count and NUW semantics, and distinguish scheduler-model artifacts from hardware evidence.

records.title: [InstCombine] Eliminate zexted i1 shuffle trees compared with zero
records.review_note: Vector Boolean array packing leaves i1-to-i8-to-i1 round trips after late SROA; cast-concat and pass-order issues require demand/width tracking, not treating byte values as arbitrary canonical masks.

records.title: [x86] optimize trunc(div i64 ..) to i32 to use 'div' instruction or multiply sequence
records.review_note: Narrow remainder of a wide multiply on i686 needs quotient-overflow/range proof or reciprocal lowering; discussion says LLVM23 fixed one case, which is not local coverage.

records.title: [x86] Failing to tail-call memcpy and memmove due to extern C
records.review_note: Recognized memcpy/memmove void intrinsics obscure returning dst and tail calls, especially i686 stack ABI. Need return-destination and stack-argument proof, not a generic tail-call toggle.

records.title: [x86] x & ~0xFFFF could be emitted as 16-bit xor
records.review_note: Clearing low 16 bits with XOR AX saves encoding but has microarchitecture-specific partial-register merge/dependency costs; avoid a blanket generic-tune substitution.

records.title: Clang failed to inline memset for SSE2 and AVX2
records.review_note: Memcpy optimization converts constant zero-fill to variable tail fill and prevents inlining. Preserve constant bounds and destination overlap semantics; backend cannot reconstruct lost original size safely.

records.title: Missed SSE optimizations: properties of math functions and more
records.review_note: SQRT preserves negative zero and can produce signed NaNs, so deleting COPYSIGN's magnitude sign mask without precise nonnegative/nonzero and FP-mode proof is unsound.

records.title: C, C11 and later: padding not set to “zero bits” in compound literal
records.review_note: Compound-literal padding initialization is a C/C++ standards/security interpretation issue, not permission to silently remove or add padding stores; distinguish whole-object zero initialization from aggregate member initialization.

records.title: [X86] Poor codegen for various 'allzeros' and 'allones' vector patterns
records.review_note: All-zero/all-one vector observations should canonicalize reduction/compare/movemask variants, but PTEST needs SSE4.1 and AVX512 mask-bitcasts complicate costs. No SSE2-only replacement by an unavailable instruction.

records.title: [X86] Matching bit test and bit set patterns appear not to work
records.review_note: Memory BT/BTS can adjust the effective address from high index bits and be microcoded; fewer assembly instructions can be slower than explicit load/test/set. Requires hardware cost and flag proof.

records.title: [x86] bitReverse of a byte or half-word can probably be optimized
records.review_note: Narrow bit reversal can use multiply+PEXT or multiply+PMOVMSKB; cross-register-file transfer, constants and shared IMUL ports make profitability CPU-dependent. Reported Zen4 gain is not universal.

records.title: [X86][AVX] Recognise out of bounds AVX2 shift amounts
records.review_note: AVX2 variable shifts saturate arithmetic counts and zero logical out-of-range counts; remove explicit clamp/select only with exact unsigned count and target intrinsic semantics. Fixed-count chain folding is narrower.

records.title: [RISC-V][X86] Bitwise NOT is computed twice
records.review_note: Choosing which NOT to absorb into ANDN affects reuse and recomputation; operand-order accidents affect both RISC-V and x86. Requires target inversion and multiuse costing.

records.title: LLVM should recognize more patterns that map to pmovmsk or similar instructions
records.review_note: ASCII compare/Boolean packing fails SLP because shift-by-zero disappears, leaving 15 shift nodes; recent copyable/reduction work reportedly fixes examples. Need mask-pack recognition, not equating OR/sum under arbitrary bytes.

records.title: [X86] Vector-Vector dot product not reduced to corresponding single DPPS or DPPD instruction
records.review_note: DPPS/DPPD matching changes the reduction tree and possibly FP exceptions/rounding; cannot substitute under strict default FP contracts merely because the mnemonic is shorter.

records.title: [X86] `and`/`or`/`xor` could use 8-bit immediate for more constant arguments
records.review_note: Byte-sized immediate AND/OR/XOR saves bytes while preserving upper register bits only for exact masks; flags and partial-register dependencies require separate codegen proof.

records.title: [X86] Unnecessary sequences of 7 GPR `mov`s back and forth
records.review_note: SIMD transpose triggers GPR eviction/copy cycles even when incidental IR changes hide the symptom; requires allocator or machine-copy liveness proof on retained old IR, not title-based closure.

records.title: [X86][AVX2][ISEL] Unnecessary masking and comparison instructions generated for movmsk
records.review_note: ISPC partially initialized wide vectors carry poison/undef high halves that block sign-bit compare-to-MOVMSKPS folding; demand analysis must isolate only observed lanes.

records.title: [X86] Use X86FixupInstTunings to select between (V)MOVSS/D and (V)BLENDPS/D
records.review_note: MOVSS/SD versus BLENDPS/PD immediate-one selection is CPU/domain/size dependent; move late to tuning rather than globally prefer one mnemonic.

records.title: Don't read from `vpcmpeqd xmm, xmm, xmm` and `vpternlogd zmm, zmm, zmm, 255` simultaneously
records.review_note: XMM and ZMM all-one idioms redundantly initialize the same register bank; wider reuse must prove upper-lane state and AVX512 permissions rather than assume XMM initialization fills ZMM.

records.title: [X86][GlobalIsel] Missing Bitwise Combine Optimization
records.review_note: GlobalISel FP classification leaves OR-with-zero and duplicate compare scaffolding; ordinary integer cleanup is relevant, but no local baseline witness or new GlobalISel pipeline is claimed.

records.title: [X86] 8-bit vector multiplication should use shift and add method for more constants
records.review_note: Byte multiply by two-power sums can avoid widening/multiply/mask/pack; SSE2 word shifts need per-byte carry masking, and AVX512 truncation changes the cost tradeoff.

records.title: [X86] Vector 8-bit shifts by variable amounts should use power of two multiply
records.review_note: Variable byte shifts can use SSSE3 power-of-two PSHUFB LUT plus multiply; large-count semantics and missing SSE2 byte shifts prohibit an unconditional baseline rewrite.

records.title: [x86] Eliminate `movzx` when upper part of register is irrelevant or overwritten
records.review_note: Demanded CTZ bits can expose useless MOVZX, but deleting extensions globally causes partial-register dependencies and rewrite loops. Keep upper-bit contracts and target-direction canonicalization.

records.title: [X86] Failure to shift-in one bits via `shld`
records.review_note: SHLD filling one bits may have higher variable-count latency/uops than BMI2 SHLX plus complement; preserve count-zero flags and prefer measured target costs over shorter assembly.

records.title: Use `pmovmskb` instead of `@llvm.vector.reduce.or.v16i8` where possible
records.review_note: OR-reduction sign observation of 16 bytes is MOVMSKB zero-test, not a full horizontal reduction. Needs consumer-specific sign-bit demand and feature-aware lowering, not arbitrary OR-to-movemask substitution.

records.title: [X86] Missed fold: `vgf2p8affineqb` + 8-bit shifts
records.review_note: GFNI affine output shifts can transform the constant matrix in the opposite byte direction, but must also shift the immediate. Needs GFNI-specific constant materialization and cost, outside SSE2.

records.title: [x86] Missed optimization: Conditional checks before vector bitshift instructions aren't folded into the bitshift instruction
records.review_note: Uniform vector shift counts saturate/zero using the low 64-bit count operand, not scalar x86 masked-count semantics; removing generic branch guards requires exact intrinsic lowering and full count width.

records.title: [x86] `and al, 7`+`movzx eax, al` => `and eax, 7`
records.review_note: AND AL then MOVZX EAX can become AND EAX only with a clearing upper-bit mask and correct flags/ABI extension. Three-lane Boolean population counts are not arbitrary byte values.

records.title: [X86] Multiple use shift amount mask not removed from SHLX
records.review_note: SHLX/SHRX/SARX ignore high count bits even when an explicit AND has other users; consumer-local operand bypass can retain the shared mask, but vector shifts and MADD52 have different truncation semantics.

records.title: [X86] Loop-invariant operand defeats vector lowering of i256/i512 CTPOP and logic ops
records.review_note: Invariant wide _BitInt operands arrive as BUILD_PAIR/CopyFromReg and fail vector-fold eligibility that loaded operands pass. Need wide-integer vectorization with invariant placement and cross-domain costs.

records.title: [x86] Missed optimization: `MEMBARRIER` pseudo-instruction prevents branch folding and elimination
records.review_note: Release atomic XCHG leaves a MEMBARRIER pseudo that obscures an empty machine block; CFG cleanup must preserve atomic ordering before removing zero-size pseudos.

records.title: [X86] i128 and/or/xor (memory from) should use simd
records.review_note: Wide i128 bitlogic memory chains may amortize GPR/XMM transfers, but scalar ABI endpoints and depth-dependent conversion costs need an actual wide-integer cost model.

records.title: [x86] Faster `truncf` and `roundf` on x86 SSE2
records.review_note: SSE2 truncf/roundf via FP-to-int roundtrip needs large-value, NaN, signed-zero, rounding-mode and exception handling; an apparent 5-10x microbenchmark win is not permission to use unchecked conversion.

records.title: [X86] Duplicate cmp when sbb and cmov use the same compare, depending on IR order
records.review_note: SBB clobbers EFLAGS needed by a later CMOV; scheduling nonclobbering consumers first can avoid a second CMP only with dependency and flags-liveness proof.

records.title: [X86] xor esi, esi appears twice, one of which is redundant
records.review_note: Body supplies only external Godbolt and screenshot of redundant XOR-zero; without retrieving the full instruction context no live-register/flags proof or local implementation is claimed.

records.title: aarch64: __builtin_shufflevector with a zero vector CST as the second argument and doing a "ext" like should produce ushr/shl
records.review_note: Zero-filled EXT-like shuffles are whole-register logical shifts with endian-dependent direction. Requires byte/lane layout tracking; arbitrary two-source four-word shuffles do not imply this.

records.title: [LLVM][LoongArch] LLVM fails to optimize shuffles from 256-bit vectors to 128-bit or smaller vectors on LASX
records.review_note: LASX narrowing shuffles spill/reload despite shuffle-only alternatives; unsupported backend, with portable subproblem requiring width-changing register projection and ABI treatment.

records.title: [VectorCombine] Recognize zero-tests of vector.reduce.umax/or
records.review_note: UMAX/OR-reduction zero observations can become lane comparisons plus Boolean reduction; avoid canonicalization loops with AArch64 UMAx preference and preserve shared reduction users.

records.title: [VectorCombine] Missed scalarization of negation through `mul` with a scalar splat
records.review_note: Wrapping negation of vector multiply by scalar splat can move to scalar before broadcast; must retain NSW/NUW and poison distinctions and account for shared splat/product producers.

records.title: [X86][Aarch64][RISCV] Dynamic vector shuffle idiom is not always recognized and optimally lowered
records.review_note: Dynamic gather/shuffle indexing with range-zeroing needs architecture-specific byte-index folding, PSHUFB high-bit semantics and correct vector ABI; stack-index scalarization is not fixed by static mask composition.

records.title: [InstCombine] Failure to narrow splatting shifts
records.review_note: Narrowing SHL/ASHR sign-splats through truncation requires exact width/bit demand; fixed-width canonical-mask shift removal is a different, narrower rule and does not peel casts.

records.title: Regression with GEPs after ""[InstCombine] Negator: -(X << C) --> X * (-1 << C)""
records.review_note: Negated shifted GEP offsets lose NSW and block inbounds-derived comparisons; pointer provenance and overflow flags are load-bearing, not inferred from arbitrary modular multiplication.

records.title: [InstCombine] try harder to peek through vector bitcasts with bitwise logic
records.review_note: Bitcast-obstructed distributive bitlogic can operate on the same register image, but needs cast-aware representation and whole-use costing; existing same-family relations alone are not coverage.

records.title: Missed optimization in InstCombine: replace usub with or
records.review_note: Borrow-only USUB chains reduce to OR plus zero observation when incoming borrow is Boolean; discarded arithmetic results are mandatory, and SBB selection remains a separate backend issue.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization: Fold `usub_sat((sub nuw C1, A), C2)` to `usub_sat(C1 - C2, A)` or `0`
records.review_note: Saturating subtraction reassociation depends on NUW C1-A (A<=C1) and constant ordering; absent that range proof the wraparound case invalidates the rewrite.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization: Fold `(sext(a) & sext(c1)) == c2` to `(a & c1) == c2` or `0`
records.review_note: Signed extension plus arbitrary AND/equality requires transforming sign-bit demand into a narrow mask; discussion corrects the original stated pattern. Constant sign/upper-bit contradictions need proof, not naive truncation.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization: merge consecutive loads whose value merged by `or`
records.review_note: Adjacent byte loads ORed into a little-endian word can merge only under alignment, endian, volatile and exact covered-byte conditions; pre-ARMv7 alignment explains a backend refusal.

records.title: [InstCombine] Failure to truncate bitreverse
records.review_note: Bitreverse truncation/extension identities require tracking which end of the source survives, including shift24 and high-byte extraction. Whole-word private bitreverse conjugation does not cover cross-width demand.

records.title: [InstCombine] Failure to infer nuw for mul nsw of non-negative
records.review_note: NSW multiply of proven nonnegative operands can imply NUW; LCCC does not import LLVM poison/no-wrap attributes from arbitrary defined integer arithmetic.

records.title: [InstCombine] Failure to factorize `add`/`sub` and `max`/`min` using distributivity
records.review_note: Min/max distribution with ADD/SUB and unsigned multiply needs monotonicity/no-overflow contracts; signed wrapping multiply is not order preserving, and FP variants need explicit fast-math semantics.

records.title: [InstCombine] folding add and compare can negatively effect codegen for loops.
records.review_note: Moving constants through loop-exit comparisons can lose flag-setting add/sub fusion and post-increment IV forms; fewer IR uses is not sufficient profitability evidence.

records.title: [InstCombine][SDAG] Add range attributes to shamts on fshl/fshr in `matchFunnelShift`
records.review_note: Funnel-shift recognition can retain a proven count range to suppress redundant masks downstream; must not infer range from undefined variable shifts or change zero-count semantics.

records.title: Mul reassociation in instcombine does not maintain NSW (for example impacting alias analysis negatively when canonicalizing GEP)
records.review_note: Multiply reassociation loses NSW/NUW and inbounds alias facts; preserving flags requires proofs for the new intermediate, not merely copying metadata from the old expression.

records.title: `(trunc nuw A) == (trunc nuw B)` should not take multiple `xor`s [InstCombine]
records.review_note: Equality of NUW/NSW truncations can lift to wide comparison only with matching no-wrap classes; mixed NSW/NUW is false, and scalar i1 is not an ordinary LCCC integer cast.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed shl + add + and optimization
records.review_note: Aligned SHL plus add47 then AND -32 can shrink the demanded constant to32; requires known low zeros and carry-aware demanded-bit analysis. Discussion indicates existing upstream handling, not a new local mechanism.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missing algebraic fold for handwritten bitwise AND
records.review_note: Handwritten per-bit AND selects can collapse only when the common shifted mask is a proven power-of-two and counts are valid; preserve short-circuit effects before loop reassociation.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization for add + and + icmp pattern
records.review_note: ADD -1/AND -3 zero test reduces to low-bit test under range [0,4); arbitrary inputs break the identity, so require real range provenance.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization for icmp of select with constants and invertible binop
records.review_note: Invertible-binop comparison against a constant-arm select can move inverse constants into the arms; a left shift is invertible only with the represented no-wrap/domain contract.

records.title: InstCombine range folding gap due to non-canonical logical-and form
records.review_note: Mixed eager-AND and select logical range chains obscure interval intersection. Need canonical Boolean provenance, short-circuit/poison treatment and range-set normalization.

records.title: `InstCombine` folds `or (select ...)` but not `or (..., select)` after PR #166102
records.review_note: Commuted OR/select zero-arm fold is symmetric semantically; an implementation must inspect both operands while preserving the same guard SSA and not speculating either arm's effects.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missing ctpop parity optimization for Add and Sub
records.review_note: Only demanded parity of sum/subtract population counts equals parity of population count of XOR. Full count values differ; scalar i1 truncation is not C Boolean conversion.

records.title: InstCombine bitwise AND with range comparison generates a huge constant.
records.review_note: Shrinking demanded AND constants can replace a sign-extended -4 immediate with an expensive positive 64-bit mask. Cost canonicalization must retain encodable redundant sign bits.

records.title: [InstCombine] missed fold for fold sub(C, or(X, C)) for constant C
records.review_note: SMAX-(x|SMAX) isolates the sign bit modulo word width; generalized constants require complement bits confined to the top bit. Ordinary arbitrary constants are counterexamples.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed sadd.sat operand-bound compare under nonnegative RHS guard
records.review_note: Signed saturating add is monotone against x for nonnegative y, including overflow saturation. Need the signed saturation intrinsic and dominating/selected RHS bound, not wrapping ADD.

records.title: [InstCombine] If a is in (0,1), then (2 >> a) to (2 - a) and (2 >> !a) to (a + 1)
records.review_note: 2>>a equals2-a only for proven a in {0,1}; Boolean-negated form gives a+1. A nonzero arbitrary word or out-of-range count is not Boolean.

records.title: [InstSimplify] missed or(zext X), (sext X) > sext X
records.review_note: OR of zero- and sign-extension of the identical narrow integer is the sign-extension; requires equal source and matching widths, not independently truncated inputs.

records.title: [InstCombine] bool mul (from memory) generated mul instead of and
records.review_note: Multiplication of loaded bool bytes becomes AND only with real canonical 0/1 load-range guarantees; raw byte objects can contain other values and Alive2 rejects the unqualified fold.

records.title: [AggressiveInstCombine] Fold consecutive loads with a common variable shift
records.review_note: Common variable-base byte-load shifts need factoring count strides and proving every count valid before widening; alignment, covered bytes and endian assembly remain separate obligations.

records.title: [AggressiveInstCombine] Fold reversed consecutive byte loads using bswap
records.review_note: Reversed byte assembly can become exact-width unaligned load plus BSWAP on x86; original alignment must remain, and backends without unaligned loads/BSWAP may regress or re-expand.

records.title: [InstCombine] and (fcmp ord x, 0), (fcmp u* x, C) is folded to fcmp o* x, C only when C is inf
records.review_note: Combining ORD with unordered compare (or UNO with ordered compare) needs the same FP value and a proven non-NaN other operand; retain signaling-NaN/FP-exception semantics rather than applying integer masks.

records.title: [InstCombine][KnownBits] Missed non-contiguous known zeros in multiplication by a power-of-two-or-zero value
records.review_note: Power-of-two-or-zero multiply preserves sparse known zeros, not just trailing zeros. Example phase&2 times9 is {0,18}; needs bit transfer and carry proofs before deleting AND or marking disjoint XOR.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed fold `ashr((zext (xor X, C)) - 1, 31)` to `sext(X == C)`
records.review_note: Narrow ZEXT XOR then subtract1/ASHR31 is an equality mask because the intermediate lies[-1,254]; losing the zero-extension or permitting full-width inputs invalidates the sign argument.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed fold `(A | B) - (A & ~B)` to `B` and `(A ^ B) - (A & ~B)` to `~A & B`
records.review_note: Union minus relative complement uses borrow-free disjoint bit sets, reducing to B; XOR sibling becomes ~A&B. Require identical SSA A/B and width, then audit existing scalar truth-table handling separately.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed folds for Carry-Save Adder identities: `(A ^ B) + ((A & B) << 1)` to `A + B` and `(A + B) - ((A & B) << 1)` to `A ^ B`
records.review_note: Carry-save ADD/XOR identities hold modulo fixed width, but no-wrap propagation onto new intermediates is separate; shared partial sums/carries require use-aware cost control.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed select-to-and fold for a low-bit condition expressed as `(x & 1) != 0`
records.review_note: Low-bit test selected y/0 equals x&y only when y is canonical0/1 and not speculative undefined data; normalize AND/ICMP Boolean form without treating arbitrary truthy y as a bit.

records.title: [InstCombine] Disjoint OR with a constant prevents common XOR reuse
records.review_note: Disjoint constant OR can be treated as XOR for reassociation to an existing common XOR, but disjointness must be proved and shared OR costs retained; upstream CSE success is not local evidence.

records.title: [BDCE] Missed per-use simplification of a shared constant OR
records.review_note: Per-use demanded-bit bypass of shared OR must preserve its full-value users; only bypass the edge whose shifted demanded mask excludes every constant bit.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization concerning relationship between x and trunc(x)
records.review_note: Nested signum/zero tests relate trunc(x)==0 to x!=0 asymmetrically: wide nonzero can truncate to zero. Requires a relational select proof, not equating wide and narrow zero tests.

records.title: [AggressiveInstCombine] failed to recognize ffmpeg u8 bitreverse table pattern
records.review_note: Recognizing a constant256-byte bitreverse lookup needs proving the complete immutable table and bounded index. A table name or sampled entries cannot justify replacing a memory access.

records.title: [x86] suboptimal codegen for isfinite IR
records.review_note: Isfinite can use exponent-class bit testing or FPCLASS; domain transfers, constant loads and NaN classification costs vary by CPU, and signaling exceptions require attention.

records.title: Use SSE for DImode store
records.review_note: i68664-bit constant stores can use SSE2 only when enabled and with legal memory semantics; x86-64 immediate MOVQ already handles0/-1 without a vector setup.

records.title: Large lookup table could be packed into 64-bit integer
records.review_note: Boolean switch tables can pack into a word bitset after range normalization; preserve bounds/default arms and avoid variable shifts outside the packed word.

records.title: [X86] Unnecessary register moves
records.review_note: Partial widening of shuffled bytes to multiple64-bit vectors needs width-changing provenance and coalescing live source slices; removing moves can clobber a still-needed widening input.

records.title: [X86] Instruction reordering prevents EFLAGS folding
records.review_note: LZCNT flags belong to the specific defining input and can be killed by zeroing/scheduling. Eliminating TEST requires exact reaching EFLAGS, not matching a nearby mnemonic.

records.title: [X86][BMI2] Investigate uses of MULX
records.review_note: MULX32 vs wider IMUL is target-, ABI-, flag- and pressure-sensitive; concatenating two32-bit results can erase savings. Do not prefer MULX purely because BMI2 exists.

records.title: [X86] Vectorize scalar conversions to avoid fpu-gpr-fpu transfers
records.review_note: Extract then signed-int-to-float conversion may stay in SIMD by shuffling the lane before CVTDQ2PS. i64sign extraction needs sign-bit provenance and legal vector width; avoid fighting earlier scalar canonicalization or changing FP exceptions on unused lanes.

records.title: Memset not shortened by DSE because of struct padding
records.review_note: DSE cannot drop pattern-initialized padding merely because fields overwrite some bytes; byte-range liveness and object observability are required. Memcpy combining/pass order can re-hide overwrite regions.

records.title: [X86] Poor vectorization array-of-bools to bitmask
records.review_note: Bool-array bitmask should compare bytes and MOVMSK, but lane0 ZEXT versus later select constants defeats SLP symmetry. Requires contiguous readable bounds and canonical bool-byte semantics, not just a generic OR reduction.

records.title: [X86] Recognize concatenated vpmovqb instructions as VPERMI2Q
records.review_note: Concatenated qword-to-byte truncation may use VPERMI2B only with AVX512VBMI and exact source-lane mapping; private equal-width dword shuffle folding is not width-changing truncate legalization.

records.title: Load folding defeated by VPCMP to VTESTNM optimization
records.review_note: Replacing zero comparison by VTESTNM can destroy a foldable memory operand because the same load becomes two uses. Include memory-folding opportunity in target choice; aligned-down strlen reads are not generally legal object loads.

records.title: [x86] Missing SLP vectorization with 32-bit multiply by loop index
records.review_note: Unrolled multiply-by-index loses SLP symmetry at multiplication by0/1; copyable elements and target multiply cost matter. SSE2 synthesized dword multiply is not universally worth vectorizing.

records.title: [X86] Use GFNI for some simple vXi8 ops like LZCNT/LSCNT/TZCNT/BSR
records.review_note: GFNI affine-byte transforms can implement count/bit-index idioms only under GFNI target permission and exact zero-input conventions. LSCNT/BSR remain distinct from byte bitreverse.

records.title: [X86][SSE2] Failure to vectorize int16_t[8] to pminsw pattern
records.review_note: SROA and aggregate ABI packing obscure eight-word PMINSW stores; reduction/copyable-element vectorization can restore middle-end form but older CPU codegen still regresses. ISA width permission is not a universal tuning preference.

records.title: [X86][SSE] Bad optimization of auto-vectorized MULH
records.review_note: Vector MULHI needs zero/sign information across broadcasts, bitcasts and loop PHIs to select PMULUDQ. Block-local shuffle identities do not establish cross-loop narrow ranges or justify widening load extents.

records.title: [X86] Failure to produce LEA from add(trunc(add(x, y)), C)
records.review_note: ADD/TRUNC/ADD can move the final add before trunc modulo result width and expose LEA; preserve flags/no-wrap and inspect shared wider intermediates rather than assuming all narrow adds deserve widening.

records.title: [X86] Failure to optimize out function prologue/epilogue in certain vector cases even though function body is empty
records.review_note: An empty vector body can still retain32-byte stack alignment from eliminated temporaries. Frame requirements must be recomputed after dead-object removal while preserving ABI/unwind and real dynamic-stack uses.

records.title: [X86] Missed combining of usubo+cmp into sbb
records.review_note: Multiword unsigned comparison can map to SUB/SBB carry chains, but lowering Boolean borrow trees requires exact flags, topology and ABI reconstruction; widening IR can instead increase instructions.

records.title: [X86] Redundant adds in -O3
records.review_note: Adjacent epilogue RSP updates become visible only after cross-block tail merging. Merging them needs CFA/unwind and flags accounting, not local textual ADD folding across labels.

records.title: Missed Optimization - Replacement of rint/lrint with X87/SSE specific instructions
records.review_note: RINT/LRINT lowering depends on current rounding mode, errno, FP exceptions, strict FENV and long-double ABI. CVT differs from CVTT; Android FP128 and constrained LRINT are not x87 hardware forms.

records.title: [X86] Failure to recognise masked store pattern
records.review_note: Masked load/select/store can become masked store only for identical pointer, predicate and inactive-lane behavior. Must preserve faults, volatility, alias order and explicit target mask support.

records.title: [x86] allow complex LEA formation with Ice Lake tuning
records.review_note: Complex LEA combines fewer instructions but has CPU-specific latency/port costs; Ice Lake, Alder Lake P/E and Zen differ. Do not generalize an ISA flag into a tuning profitability guarantee.

records.title: [X86] Failure to reassociate PMULUDQ mul-by-constant pairs of nodes
records.review_note: PMULUDQ constant-pair reassociation includes implicit zero-extension and even-lane selection; multiply-by-one lanes help only with exact lane/width tracking and nonduplicated live producers.

records.title: [Backend][X86] Incorrect output + missed optimization for function marked as clang::musttail
records.review_note: Musttail argument relocation can overwrite the return address; copying by-value aggregates requires an ABI-safe parallel-copy schedule, not an ordinary tail-call peephole.

records.title: [x86] Missed optimization with bsr
records.review_note: BSR implements floor-log2 only for nonzero input unless zero is explicitly selected to -1; defined C++ bit_width and undefined builtin CLZ contracts must remain distinct.

records.title: [X86][13 regression] Suboptimial i128 subtraction
records.review_note: i128 subtraction should retain wide arithmetic semantics through ABI split/concat; demanded-bit reassociation and shared uses can hide SUB/SBB. A smaller split IR can still have worse carry recognition.

records.title: [X86] Prefer immediate operand to stack folded operand
records.review_note: A stack-folded OR with a separately materialized constant can cost more backend micro-ops than a load plus immediate OR; instruction count and microfusion alone do not determine RS/port pressure.

records.title: [X86] Terrible codegen for splat2 i32 memory copies
records.review_note: Repeated two-dword copies need load/splat/store grouping across loop iterations; widening changes memory bounds and alias scheduling. Byte/lane provenance across AVX1 split vectors is not fixed dword permutation composition.

records.title: [X86] Failure to merge cvtdq2ps nodes
records.review_note: Merging scalar CVTDQ2PS conversions from a common vector needs exact lane-source provenance and non-power-of-two stores; preserve exception behavior of additional converted lanes.

records.title: [x86] Conditional stack frame uses add rsp instead of pop on minsize
records.review_note: Size-oriented conditional frames may use POP for8-byte release only with a safe dead destination, matching unwind information, flags and frame layout. Do not add an observable memory read speculatively.

records.title: [X86] `sub`+`cmp`+`jmp` could be combined into `sub`+`jmp`
records.review_note: SUB/CMP/Jcc fusion needs the correct live flags and no illegal hoisting of condition-dependent NSW arithmetic. DEC leaves CF unchanged, and other users of eliminated TEST flags must be checked.

records.title: [X86] Failure to consolidate integer/double loads of the same bit constant
records.review_note: Integer and FP broadcasts of identical bits can share a physical vector constant only with bitcast-aware representation and live-range cost; numeric equality is insufficient for FP NaNs/signed zero.

records.title: [X86] Recognize Clang's `<=>` code pattern
records.review_note: Three-way comparison select chains can become SCMP/UCMP or two SETcc plus subtract; preserve signedness and exact {-1,0,1} result encoding. Source spelling alone does not provide an intrinsic.

records.title: [x86] unnecessary jmp to ret
records.review_note: Jump-to-return elimination must account for epilogue/unwind state, return-value liveness and shared tail placement; replacing a jump to a bare RET differs from skipping a frame teardown.

records.title: [x86] Suboptimal expansion of `icmp` on `i1`
records.review_note: Boolean comparison can use AND/XOR identities only for canonical0/1 operands and correct signedness; branch/select consumers need flags-aware costing beyond returned-bool microbenchmarks.

records.title: Suboptimal vpshufb of broadcast
records.review_note: PSHUFB of a partial scalar broadcast can require a full broadcast before byte shuffle. Need all demanded bytes defined across128-bit lanes; undef/poison insertion does not justify reading unspecified byte sources.

records.title: [X86] Poor codegen for SSE ((x == 1) || (x == 2))
records.review_note: Unsigned adjacent-constant range comparison may cost more than two equality compares on SSE2 lacking unsigned compare/min. Target-specific inverse canonicalization needs costed constants and wrap-correct endpoints.

records.title: [X86] Poor codegen for hand-written abs(char) function
records.review_note: Narrow abs register coalescing trades a move against REX prefixes for DIL accesses. ABI liveness, partial-register effects and size/speed objectives matter; fewer moves is not universally smaller.

records.title: [X86] Avoid large constants for min_signed_value check
records.review_note: NEG overflow isolates signed minimum without a64-bit immediate, but destroys its input and flags. Require private/dead input or costed copy and correct32/64-bit OF semantics.

records.title: [x86] The x86 backend seems to break the cse optimizations
records.review_note: Late slow-LEA splitting can duplicate previously common subexpressions; need machine-level reaching-definition CSE after transformation with safe register/flag liveness.

records.title: [X86] Duplicate XMM/YMM constant data
records.review_note: Different-width FP sign masks can share constant-pool storage or broadcast base bytes with alignment and relocation bounds. This is data-layout/constant lowering, not a Boolean mask algebra change.

records.title: [SROA][X86] LLVM failed to merge two aligned i32 store into one i64 store
records.review_note: Rejoin adjacent low/high32 stores into64 only with exact covered bytes, ordering, alignment and volatile/atomic exclusions. C source pointer punning is not itself an alias proof.

records.title: [X86] LLVM cannot reuse same vector constants
records.review_note: Constant-pool reuse across vector widths requires prefix identity and sufficient alignment; broadcast choices trade load bandwidth, code size and target availability, not just repeated elements.

records.title: [x86] Bad optimization of a multiply by a scalar register that came from a vector
records.review_note: Scalar multiply extracted from a vector may be cheaper in GPRs than reconstructing vector operations. Include transfers, broadcast constants and live vector reuse in the target domain cost.

records.title: [X86] Improper optimization of switching operations
records.review_note: Swap-loop load/store scheduling on Zen4 needs memory-bank/dispatch and alias-dependence modelling; reordering adjacent arrays without alias proof changes behavior.

records.title: [X86] Prefer trunc(reduce(x)) over reduce(trunc(x))
records.review_note: Modulo add/mul/bitwise reductions commute with final truncation, allowing wide reduction then scalar trunc; signed overflow/poison flags and exact supported reduction types must be preserved.

records.title: [X86] Inconsistent bool splat codegen
records.review_note: Scalar bool to all-one vector can use canonicalize/NEG/broadcast, with SSE2 dword broadcast rather than unavailable byte broadcast; prove0/1 and preserve explicit feature denial.

records.title: [X86] Possible missed optimization with truncating vector cast
records.review_note: Four-word to four-byte truncation needs packing low bytes, not simply low32-bit store; reported expected assembly must be checked against actual lane layout and load width.

records.title: [X86] Attempt to perform AVX1 v8i32 integer comparisons as v8f32
records.review_note: AVX1 integer comparisons in FP domain require injective conversion bounds and MXCSR DAZ/FTZ/NaN considerations; exactness of one constant is insufficient and bitcasts are not numeric conversion.

records.title: [X86] [ISEL] Redundant instructions selected for storing vector of floats
records.review_note: Extract/insert roundtrips around MAXPS stores are separated by bitcasts; need byte-exact register provenance and legal contiguous memory reconstruction, not arbitrary cast peeling.

records.title: [X86] v4f16 -> v4i32 conversion unnecessarily using YMM registers
records.review_note: Half-to-int conversion can shrink YMM to XMM when high lanes are undemanded, but legalization, conversion exceptions and ABI upper-lane definitions must agree.

records.title: [X86] Failure to merge X86ISD::CVTPH2PS nodes
records.review_note: Merge half-to-float conversion nodes before lane extraction only with common input and demand mapping; zero/undef padded lanes and FP exceptions need explicit handling.

records.title: Missed optimization: extractps optimizes better than pshufd+movd
records.review_note: Narrow scalar load from a shared vector load can avoid PSHUFD/MOVD, but preserve volatile/atomic access extent and multiple consumers; one-use limits cannot simply be removed.

records.title: [Optimisations] [X86] Storing an `i4 zeroext` into an `i8` then loading that `i8` still creates code to store the `i8` even when not used
records.review_note: BitInt4 byte storage requires correct padding/zeroext facts and dead-store elimination; non-byte accesses and bitcast memory representation are frontend contracts, not ordinary i1 logic.

records.title: [X86] `@llvm.ceil.f16` is ~6x slower than GCC on Intel Raptor Lake
records.review_note: FP16 scalar ABI relays and unused frames can dominate CEIL cost; target AVX512FP16 availability, F16C conversion rounding and precise call ABI are separate from generic arithmetic.

records.title: [x86] Chained `blsr`s can be optimized to a `pdep` (since Haswell on Intel, since Zen 3 on AMD)
records.review_note: Repeated clear-lowest-bit maps to PDEP of a shifted mask only with BMI2 profitability and defined count>=width handling; pre-Zen3 AMD PDEP is slow.

records.title: Ineffectual por with constant emitted for pshufb operand
records.review_note: PSHUFB ignores control bits4-6, not bit7 (which zeroes output); OR112 can be removed only as lane-local control demand, preserving high-bit zero semantics.

records.title: [X86] Non-optimal codegen for bool to float conversions with `select i1 %0, float 1.0, float 0.0`
records.review_note: Bool select of FP1/0 can use unsigned conversion after canonicalization, but target conversion versus constant selection cost and strict FP semantics determine profitability.

records.title: [X86] Useless SIMD<->GPR transfers for f16 arithmetic
records.review_note: FP16 arithmetic can remain in SIMD and fold final word extraction into a store; maintain ABI word placement and distinguish hardware half arithmetic from promote/round sequences.

records.title: [X86] Bad mulhi codegen
records.review_note: Vector word MULHI selection needs nonnegative extension, signed constant range and high-product algebra; changing multiplier changes legality of PMULHW/PMULHUW substitutions.

records.title: [x86][znver3] Dead 32-byte constant accessed via `vbroadcasti128` not eliminated from assembly
records.review_note: A narrowed VBROADCASTI128 constant can leave dead32-byte pool storage; dead-pool cleanup and live relocation reachability are needed, not changing PSHUFB high-bit semantics.

records.title: [X86] Constant hoisting results in suboptimal top bit clearing
records.review_note: Constant hoisting can block BZHI/BEXTR immediate recognition and mix masking strategies; carry known constant provenance through backend without globalizing per-use costs.

records.title: [DAG][X86] Use shrdq to insert into a bitfield
records.review_note: Top-field insertion via SHL+SHRD is valid for1<=count<width, not0 without handling the width-count shift; slow SHLD/SHRD targets and flag effects need costing.

records.title: ymm `vpshufb` unnecessarily split into two xmm `vpshufb`s
records.review_note: A full YMM PSHUFB before split may beat two XMM shuffles, despite undef upper demand. Need128-bit lane boundaries and two-source blend provenance, beyond private dword composition.

records.title: [X86] AVX1 targets failure to recognise VPTEST YMM pattern
records.review_note: AVX1 can implement equality reductions with FP-domain XOR/OR plus VPTEST, but integer AVX2 encodings remain forbidden; exact whole-bit reduction and feature routing are necessary.

records.title: [x86] Un-optimal use of upper registers while generating vpmaddwd for reductions
records.review_note: Partial dot-product reduction leaves upper accumulator lanes zero; shrinking ZMM operations needs loop-PHI zero knowledge and final reduction accounting, not a local zero-producing instruction alone.

records.title: [x86] Opportunity to use shorter encoding for comparisons against powers of two
records.review_note: Power-of-two compare may encode longer than destructive right-shift/test; size optimization must include input liveness, flags and shift cost, not simply normalize every condition to CMP.

records.title: [X86] Failure to recognise hidden <2 x i64> ashr
records.review_note: Hidden qword ASHR63 is dword sign extraction followed by high-dword duplication across bitcasts. Needs cross-granularity reconstruction; implemented mask proof does not create unavailable SSE2 qword arithmetic shifts.

records.title: [x86] Unneccessary mov in loop over bits
records.review_note: Bit-scan loops need destination dependency handling and destructive AND coalescing; BSF zero behavior differs from TZCNT and legacy REP decoding, so target/flags/live-value facts matter.

records.title: [X86] Unnecessary promotion for fneg / fabs half calls
records.review_note: Half FNEG/FABS must toggle/clear sign bits without promotion that quiets signaling NaNs, even atO0. Bitwise operations do not require AVX512FP16 arithmetic.

records.title: [X86] Failure to merge PINSRW insertions
records.review_note: Repeated word insertion into both YMM halves may share a broadcast and blend; preserve untouched lanes, exact insertion indices and scalar transfer costs.

records.title: [X86] Suboptimal codegen for broadcasting a 16-bit vector element
records.review_note: High-word broadcast can use local word shuffle plus cross-qword permutation; target-specific lane provenance and128-bit partitions are needed instead of broad VPERMD constants.

records.title: [X86] `acc -= val < 0` converted to less efficient `acc += (val >> 7) & 1`
records.review_note: Byte sign-count accumulation should retain compare masks and use SUB rather than synthesized byte shifts. Avoid rewrite oscillation/infinite loops with canonical compare-to-shift transforms.

records.title: [X86] mulhu + srl pattern not recognized
records.review_note: Word unsigned MULHI followed by extra right shift can replace widened product shifts>=16; prove zero extensions, count bounds and signedness before choosing PMULHUW.

records.title: [x86] why llvm keep rodata.const section
records.review_note: Late removal of all constant accesses may leave an unreferenced pool object; linker GC is not compiler DCE, and address/relocation reachability must be checked.

records.title: [X86] Use `vpinsrq` in building 2-element vector of 64-bit int loads
records.review_note: Twoqword loads can form a vector with PINSRQ memory source only with SSE4.1 permission, exact access order/alias behavior and target domain/throughput cost.

records.title: [X86] Poor emulation of cmpss pattern
records.review_note: Scalar CMPEQSS reconstruction needs lane0 compare-mask bits and untouched upper lanes from the correct operand; full-vector compare or numerical mask-to-float conversion is not equivalent.

records.title: [X86] `const << (x&7)` doesn't use `shlx` when BMI2 is available
records.review_note: BMI2 wide variable shifts can replace constrained byte shifts while preserving low-byte storage, but count&7 and constant hoisting must remain and flags cannot be reused.

records.title: [X86] Failure to reduce extended i64 add/sub/mul arithmetic to i32 with known zeros in the upper 32-bits
records.review_note: Narrowing known-zero-upper64 arithmetic requires proving result upper bits, not merely both inputs: ADD/MUL can carry high, SUB can underflow. Width-specific flags and modular demand determine legality.

records.title: [X86] 64-bit constant compiled to `movabs`+`add` after branch
records.review_note: Hoisted64-bit base constants can become single-use after branch simplification; refold displacement into MOVABS with use-aware backend constant propagation and encoding cost.

records.title: [SLPVectorizer][X86] Addition no longer vectorized
records.review_note: Loop-carried byte sums lose SLP profitability through load/shift/truncate buildvector costing. Need PHI and copyable-element handling, not just local packed ADD support.

records.title: [X86] bcmp with zero not vectorized
records.review_note: Zero-BCMP expansion should permit vector OR/test reductions with exact readable length and unaligned loads; all-one XOR/AND analogs do not establish alignment for baseline SSE.

records.title: [X86][GlobalIsel] Missed optimization for memory access
records.review_note: Narrowing float FABS load-op-store to one sign byte is a memory-width rewrite with volatile/atomic and alias-order exclusions; little-endian byte location is target-specific.

records.title: [x86] Could use `cqo` for sign-extending to 128 bits
records.review_note: CQO sign-extension to128 bits is profitable only after ABI register assignment or with constrained-register costs; early RAX/RDX forcing can cause extra copies/spills.

records.title: [x86]: Failure to use LEA for base + index + displacement
records.review_note: Base+scaled-index+displacement LEA choice depends on Slow3OpsLEA tuning and flag liveness, not mere instruction-count reduction.

records.title: [X86] Avoid spilling whole vectors where only a subvector will be extracted after reload
records.review_note: Partial vector spill should extract before store, not only reload a smaller slice from a wide spill; store-to-load forwarding, all-use subregister demand and allocator liveness must be modelled.

records.title: [X86] bf16 to float conversion fails to stay on FPU
records.review_note: BF16 extension can shift the16-bit payload within SIMD rather than roundtrip GPRs; preserve ABI low-word representation and BF16 NaN semantics distinct from IEEEhalf conversion.

records.title: [x86] Missing patterns to utilize "vtest" instructions fully.
records.review_note: Reduction predicates can map to PTEST or sign-bit TESTPS/PD depending on demanded bits, but CFG short-circuit splitting can move a reduction across blocks. Scalar mask proofs do not solve global reduction placement.

records.title: [X86] Poor code generation for boolean vectors on AVX2
records.review_note: Boolean vector bitcast operations may be folded before integer/scalar conversion only with packed-bit layout and mask provenance; AVX512 mask legalization is not required for every Boolean bitwise expression.

records.title: [X86] Backend should elide vector store-to-temporary used with `VPEXPAND`.
records.review_note: Store-to-temp then masked expandload may become register expand with exact memory dependence, mask and packed-element order; a memory intrinsic cannot drop observable memory arbitrarily.

records.title: [X86] X86FixupInstTunings - attempt to convert VPERMQri to VINSERTI128rri
records.review_note: VPERMQ0x44 register splat may become VINSERTI128 only for that specific mapping and scheduler cost; memory-folded VPERMQ should not be replaced blindly.

records.title: [x86][armv8] Failure to use flag in unsigned underflow compare idiom
records.review_note: Unsigned sub/min/max idioms can reuse borrow flags, but need stable operand/freeze semantics and target-aware lowering to avoid inverse-expansion loops and AArch64 regressions.

records.title: [X86] Suboptimal reusable vpshufb
records.review_note: Reusable PSHUFB plus cheap UNPCK can beat a merged two-source permutation; retained producer costs and specialized shuffle cost classes must be included.

records.title: [X86] Failure to merge VPTERNLOG patterns
records.review_note: Three-input complemented OR can map to one VPTERNLOG with correct truth-table immediate, tied destination and AVX512 permission; SSE2 Boolean-tree mask proof does not emit ternary instructions.

records.title: [META][X86] Improve _BitInt codegen
records.review_note: Meta BitInt optimization tracker is not one independently implementable pattern; preserve it as reviewed scope without counting linked children as solved work.

records.title: [X86] Poor codegen when accessing a single bit of very large integers
records.review_note: Single-bit access in huge integers can select word i/64 and bit i%64 under proven bounds/endian layout. The report's illustrative i/64 bit shift must not be copied as correct code.

records.title: [X86] Investigate CTTZ large _BitInt codegen
records.review_note: Large BitInt CTZ can first find the nonzero word then count once, or use vector masks/compress; retain all-zero result, full readable bounds and exact offset ordering.

records.title: [X86] Poor codegen for NE/EQ zero/allones comparisons for very large integers
records.review_note: Wide equality to0/-1 can reduce legal-width chunks before testing; private-use/load-fold restrictions and precise tail bits remain necessary for non-multiple widths.

records.title: [X86] Failure to fold bit count instructions if EFLAGS is used
records.review_note: LZCNT memory folding plus CF reuse needs a single flags-producing operation whose carry reaches the select. Freeze/use topology and scheduler flags cannot be ignored.

records.title: [X86] Poor LZCNT/TZCNT expansion of very large integers
records.review_note: Recursive huge CLZ expansion creates many counts/selects and spills; sequential word discovery or flags chains need global legalization and zero-input contracts, not local arithmetic folding.

records.title: [X86] Failure to merge BT with matching BTC/BTR/BTS
records.review_note: BTR/BTS/BTC already return the original bit in CF, allowing BT elimination only for the same address/bit and unchanged carry; memory bit-index address adjustment and atomic semantics matter.

records.title: [X86] LLVM -Oz generates 8-byte move for small constants
records.review_note: MOVABS of1 is longer than zero-extending MOV32; choose encoding after64-bit constant hoisting and account for live upper bits and stack effects before PUSH/POP alternatives.

records.title: [X86] Unnecessary repeated costly comparisons in multiple blocks
records.review_note: Sinking an expensive wide comparison into multiple blocks duplicates reduction work; retain a dominating Boolean result with costed liveness and avoid assuming multiple condition-code registers on x86.

records.title: [x86] Missed optimization for AVX2 truncating cast from v8i32 to v8i8
records.review_note: Dword-to-byte truncation must pack corresponding bytes from both AVX2 halves before concat; byte provenance through bitcasts and exact8-byte store bounds are missing prerequisites.

records.title: [X86] Vector conditional increment needlessly lengthens the dependency chain when the condition needs inversion
records.review_note: Conditional vector increment inversion should be independent of accumulator when cheaper, avoiding serialized decrement+increment; preserve modular byte arithmetic and use addlike/disjoint-OR matching without oscillation.

records.title: [X86] Failure to merge consecutive ISD::BUILD_VECTOR / ISD::INSERT_VECTOR_ELT elements
records.review_note: Adjacent inserts of low/high halves can rebuild original wide scalars with endian-aware bitcasts; require exact source equality, lane indices and no demanded undef slots.

records.title: LLVM memcpy/set optimizations prevented by uninitialized padding
records.review_note: Temporary initialization/copy can target destination directly only while untouched uninitialized padding remains untouched and alias/order facts permit forwarding; cannot blanket-initialize padding as a shortcut.

records.title: [X86] Missed combining of `adc` + `add` with constant arguments
records.review_note: ADC with constant can absorb adjacent ADD only when carry-in survives and the final flags correspond to the combined sum; intermediate flags or shared sums prohibit naive fusion.

records.title: LLVM fails to optimize out i32/i64 smin/smax down to PMINSW/PMAXSW on x86 with SSE2 when values are known to be within i16 range
records.review_note: Wider signed min/max may use PMINSW only when complete wide lanes are sign-extended16-bit values; packed high words participate consistently. Unsigned leading-zero analogs require distinct proof.

records.title: Improving performance of 2xi64 icmp slt/sgt/ult/ugt on SSE2 using 2xi64 sub
records.review_note: SSE2qword comparison alternatives must produce complete0/-1 lanes despite absent PSRAQ; subtract/high-dword equality and bitwise borrow variants need measured shuffle-port and register-pressure evidence.

records.title: [X86] Attrocious code when using a multiple of the index of the most significant bit.
records.review_note: Scaled MSB index can cancel CLZ/BSR XORs through shifts, but nonzero input and target scan costs remain; BSR false dependencies/AMD microcoding can outweigh instruction-count savings.

records.title: [x86] LLVM generates movabs + const add instead of single movabs
records.review_note: Late MOVABS plus constant LEA can refold when the base constant is truly dead after the use, preserving relocation and flags behavior; hoisted shared constants need separate cost.

records.title: [X86] manual `avg` optimizes poorly
records.review_note: Rounded unsigned byte average can be hidden by demanded-bit masking of widened sums; recover exact (a+b+1)>>1 semantics and legal widths before using PAVGB, preserving rounding direction.

records.title: [X86] Match PCLMULQDQ codegen with llvm.clmul intrinsic implementation
records.review_note: Generic carryless multiply needs zero-folds and lane selection folded into PCLMUL immediate; this is polynomial multiplication with target permission, not integer MUL or ordinary shuffle reassociation.

records.title: [X86] Generation of slower vperm2f128 (?)
records.review_note: MCA repeated-block dependencies can misrepresent one-shot shuffle construction; compare actual source dependencies and memory folds, with native timing rather than accepting the estimate as fact.

records.title: [X86] Missed Fold: `vgf2p8affineqb(x, m1) ^ vgf2p8affineqb(x, m2)` => `vgf2p8affineqb(x, m1 ^ m2)`
records.review_note: GFNI affine XOR combination follows GF(2) linearity with identical input, XORed matrices and affine constants; shared producers and GFNI permission govern profitability.

records.title: [X86] Missed Fold: `vgf2p8affineqb(x, m, imm8) ^ C` => `vgf2p8affineqb(x, m, imm8 ^ C)`
records.review_note: Post-affine XOR folds into GFNI immediate only for one identical splatted8-bit constant across all matrix blocks; arbitrary per-byte constants do not fit one immediate.

records.title: [X86] Poor codegen when bitcasting boolean vectors larger than 64 bits
records.review_note: 128Boolean vector ABI can expand to128byte arguments rather than a packed128-bit integer; lowering needs explicit ABI bit packing and defined upper bits, not assuming vector_size memory layout.

records.title: [X86] Missed Fold: `vgf2p8affineqb(x ^ C, M, imm8)` => `vgf2p8affineqb(x, M, (u8)vgf2p8affineqb(C, M, imm8))`
records.review_note: Pre-affine XOR folds into the immediate only after transforming the constant by the same matrix, which must give the same byte correction in every64-bit matrix block.

records.title: [X86] Missed Fold: `vgf2p8affineqb(vgf2p8affineqb(x, C1), C2)` => `vgf2p8affineqb(x, C3)`
records.review_note: Compose GFNI affine maps by matrix multiplication in the instruction's reversed bit-row convention and transformed affine offset; not ordinary byte permutation or integer matrix multiplication.

records.title: [X86] Vector 64-bit `icmp ugt + blend` with constant should use arithmetic to avoid compare
records.review_note: Qword compare used solely as BLENDV sign mask can use arithmetic sign tests with constant-range cases; it cannot replace full canonical compare masks consumed by arbitrary Boolean users.

records.title: [X86] Vector 8-bit `icmp ugt + blend` with constant should use saturation arithmetic to avoid compare
records.review_note: Byte saturating add/sub can synthesize just the blend/movemask sign decision for constant thresholds; preserve saturation limits and exclude full-mask consumers needing all bits canonical.

records.title: [X86] `broadcast16(movemask8(x))` needlessly duplicates the mask as a scalar
records.review_note: MOVMSK16 followed by word broadcast should duplicate in SIMD rather than repeatedly expand the scalar64-bit value; maintain exact16-bit mask and supported broadcast widths.

records.title: [X86] Missed Fold: `x ^ vgf2p8affineqb(x, M)` => `vgf2p8affineqb(x, M ^ IDENTITY)`
records.review_note: XOR ofx with its GFNI affine map equals matrix XOR identity, with instruction-specific identity0x0102040810204080 and unchanged affine offset; constant matrix/use guards remain.

records.title: [X86] llvm.scmp(X, 0)) generates suboptimal code
records.review_note: Signed signum ofi128 can combine high-word sign and full-value nonzero without generic SCMP subtraction; preserve {-1,0,1}, wide zero and return-extension ABI.

records.title: [X86] Redundant spill/reloads when indexing ext_vector_type with non-constant
records.review_note: Dynamic vector indexing should reuse original memory only with no intervening modifications and valid index semantics; register-only values may require a spill, but loop-invariant spills need safe hoisting.

records.title: [X86] Missed Fold: `vgf2p8affineqb(x, M1, imm8) & C` => `vgf2p8affineqb(x, M2, imm8 & C)`
records.review_note: GFNI post-AND zeros output matrix rows in reverse bit order and masks affine immediate; only uniform byte constants and constant/use-costed matrices fit one instruction.

records.title: [X86] Missed Fold: `vgf2p8affineqb(x, M1, imm8) | C` => `vgf2p8affineqb(x, M2, imm8 | C)`
records.review_note: GFNI post-OR zeros forced output rows and sets corresponding immediate bits, with reverse row order. Unlike disjoint OR, this requires full matrix transformation, not an assumed zero input bit.

records.title: [X86] Missed Reassociation: `vgf2p8affineqb(x & splat(C), m)` => `vgf2p8affineqb(x, m & splat(C))`
records.review_note: Pre-affine byte AND clears the same source-bit positions in every matrix row; affine offset stays unchanged. Moving variable masks changes dependency/cost and needs target-specific evidence.

records.title: [X86] Missed Fold: `vgf2p8affineqb(x | C, M, imm8)` => `vgf2p8affineqb(x, M & ~C, (u8)vgf2p8affineqb(C, M, imm8))`
records.review_note: Pre-affine OR is masked-input XOR constant: clear input columns and transform the constant into the shared immediate, requiring equivalent matrices/corrections across blocks.

records.title: [X86][APX] worse fp compare with -ffast-math
records.review_note: Fast-math FP comparison lowering can worsen Boolean/flag sequences even on APX; preserve ordered/unordered contracts before changing flag-combining or conditional-compare policy.

records.title: [AVX] Prefer `VPUNPCKHBW` to `VPSHUFD` to save 1 byte in I$
records.review_note: A byte broadcast seed may use UNPCKHBW rather than an immediate PSHUFD for size, but only when source byte mapping and128-bit lane selection match; cost includes prefixes/register ties.

records.title: [X86] i128 mask/update regression after wide integer bitlogic is lowered through XMM
records.review_note: Routing i128 bitlogic through XMM can lose low-half-only stores and force full-width updates/transfers. Late single-use cleanup and scalar extraction should be revisited, not unconditionally prefer SIMD for wide scalars.

records.title: [X86][SROA] memcpy of `i128` not optimized out
records.review_note: Memcpy forwarding through pointer PHI depends on destination allocation representation and path-sensitive alias/lifetime facts. Typed i128 versus byte array should not erase necessary per-path initialization.

records.title: [X86] SSE v4f32 isinf/isnan mask result in different ways:
records.review_note: FP comparison0/-1 masks can become integer0/1 via shift rather than pool AND, but FP/integer domain transitions and signaling behavior need target-aware cost.

records.title: [x86] `cmp r, 64`+`jbe`+`add r, -64` => `sub r, 64`+`jbe`
records.review_note: Compare length before loop decrement can reuse SUB flags only with PHI/control-flow-aware scheduling and no illegal operation hoisting across the exit path.

records.title: [x86] Unnecessary `mov`, conditionally jumped to, that disrupts another block's fallthrough should be removed
records.review_note: Discussion corrects the allegedly redundant MOV: it may be needed for one path. CFG-aware copy placement/CMOV and fallthrough layout are prerequisites, not deletion by nearby register spelling.

records.title: [X86] suboptimal codegen with -march=znver4
records.review_note: Zen4wide-vector tuning exposes poorly legalized Boolean masks beyond64bits; AVX512 permission and frequency preferences do not prove a particular512-bit lowering is profitable.

records.title: [X86] Auto-vectorizer doesn't synthesize PMULHRSW from `(a * b + 0x2000) >> 14` / `(a * b + 0x4000) >> 15` patterns
records.review_note: Fixed-point multiply-round needs exact PMULHRSW semantics: it is NOT general saturating narrowing, and MIN*MIN produces wrapped0x8000. Q14doubling also needs signed16-bit bounds and exact rounding/truncation proof.

records.title: [X86] Missing use of 8-/16-bit `cmp` for comparing truncated values
records.review_note: Narrow CMP can eliminate zero extensions for truncated operands if unsigned/signed conditions use the same low width; partial-register, REX and16-bit prefix costs matter.

records.title: [X86] Implement `vgf2p8mulb(x, splat(C))` using `vgf2p8affineqb` to allow for more optimization opportunities
records.review_note: GFNI multiply by a byte constant is a linear GF(2^8) map and may become an affine matrix to expose folding; verify the AES polynomial, reversed matrix encoding and all256inputs.

records.title: [X86] Missed Fold: `vgf2p8affineqb(x0, m) ^ vgf2p8affineqb(x1, m)` => `vgf2p8affineqb(x0 ^ x1, m)`
records.review_note: Equal-matrix GFNI outputs XOR by linearity into affine(x0^x1), with XORed immediates; shared affine producers and domain costs must be retained.

records.title: [X86] Missed Optimization: Vector 8-bit `rotl(x, 1)` should be lowered as `(x + x) - (x < 0)`
records.review_note: Byte rotate-left1 equals doubled byte minus signed-negative mask modulo256; requires exact byte comparison mask and no cross-byte carry from word shifts.

records.title: [X86] Missed Optimization: Vector 8-bit `rotr(x, 1)` should be lowered as `pavgb(x, -(x & 1))`
records.review_note: Byte rotate-right1 equals rounded unsigned average with -(x&1); use9-bit scalar proof for average sum and preserve wrap of the sign-insertion mask.

records.title: [X86] Missed Optimization: Vector 8-bit `ashr(x, 1)` should be lowered as `pavgb(x, -1) ^ (~x & 0x80)`
records.review_note: Byte ASHR1 can use rounded unsigned average with255 then XOR complemented sign bit; prove all256byte values and target average/logic costs before lowering.

records.title: [X86] EltsFromConsecutiveLoads - handle trunc(wideload()) patterns
records.review_note: Combining strided narrow reads into wide-load+trunc may read gaps not covered by originals. Need whole-range dereferenceability/alignment and exact tail/lane mapping, especially ABI stack arguments.

records.title: [X86] Inc with memory operand not formed with frozen load
records.review_note: Freeze of loaded data cannot move onto the pointer; memory INC folding requires load/store dependence and defined concrete value semantics, not arbitrary freeze peeling.

records.title: [X86] using f64/f32 division to lower vector i32/i16/i8 division
records.review_note: FP-based vector integer division needs exact quotient conversion/error bounds, rounding modes, zero/overflow behavior and FP exception contracts. Suspicious scheduler divide costs are not proof of correctness or universal speed.

records.title: [X86] failed to lower llround llroundf lround lroundf to native instruction
records.review_note: LROUND/LLROUND require ties-away-from-zero rather than MXCSR rounding; retain errno/FP exceptions, range handling, i686 result ABI and size-sensitive libcall policy.

records.title: [X86] Missed optimization for SIMD `icmp uge 16xi8` when one of the paramters is known to be less than `0x80`
records.review_note: Byte UGE threshold sign masks can use saturating add only with RHS<=128 and exact128-RHS adjustment; UGT uses a different boundary, and full canonical mask users are not covered.

records.title: [X86] failed to eliminate redundant vroundsd/vroundss before vcvttsd2si/vcvttss2si
records.review_note: Eliminating ROUND before truncating FP-to-int conversion must preserve ties-away behavior and defined conversion range/FP exceptions; no blanket replacement of round by current-mode CVT.

records.title: [X86] Failure to create BLSI instruction from integer reprensentable as i8
records.review_note: Narrow lowbit isolation can use32-bit BLSI when the value is known zero-extended and low-byte result is demanded; keep BMI1 permission and correct0 behavior.

records.title: [X86] Suboptimal generation of same-argument cmpunord
records.review_note: Self unordered FP compare can avoid materializing zero for the other operand, but signaling/quiet predicate semantics and upper-lane passthrough must match.

records.title: [X86][Codegen] Adjacent VPTERNLOG is not optimized
records.review_note: A three-input carry/majority Boolean web can combine to one VPTERNLOG truth table232 with correct input permutation; post-isel shared uses and tied destination need accounting.

records.title: [X86] CompressEVEX - extend tryCompressVPMOVPattern to handle VBLENDV patterns as well
records.review_note: Mask-register extraction plus EVEX masked move may compress into VBLENDV only with matching sign-mask granularity, destination passthrough and liveness; shorter encoding is target/register dependent.

records.title: [X86] Computed goto with a single possible target lowered to an indirect branch (`jmp *%reg`) at -O2 instead of a direct jump
records.review_note: Discussion corrects the single-target premise: PHI contains two blockaddresses. Loop-header jump threading may remove indirect branches but can create irreducible loops; preserve cleanup, CFI and CFG structure.

records.title: sse code spiller suboptimality (only 2 registers used for 280 instructions)
records.review_note: Reassessed: discussion corrects the two-register premise: all XMM registers are used and live-range splitting/spiller quality is central. New private packed rewrites do not repair allocator fragmentation; ignore third-party model verdict as evidence.

records.title: x86 codegen for long AddRec expansion could be improved
records.review_note: Reassessed: long add-recurrence spills relate to reassociation/SCEV and scheduling; upstream closed-form success does not prove local polynomial-loop elimination. Still deferred outside packed SSA scope.

records.title: unnecessary moves between XMM and general registers by x86 back end
records.review_note: Reassessed: FP/GPR domain transfers cross bitcasts, conditional paths and FP round/sign logic. Pure integer mask proof does not permit numerical FP rewrites or global domain assignment.

records.title: [x86 code size] Inefficient encoding of cmp/test with immediate argument and dead register
records.review_note: Reassessed: destructive compares may shrink encoding but change CF/OF and macrofusion/input liveness. No broad INC/DEC substitution without exact condition and size policy.

records.title: missed bswap.
records.review_note: Reassessed: in-place byte-swap loop needs whole-object alias/read-write dependence and idiom reconstruction. Packed shifts do not establish legal load/store replacement.

records.title: gcc tail merges cases that llvm doesn't
records.review_note: Reassessed: tail merging indirect virtual calls requires CFG equivalence, unwind and register-copy integration; no safe local fold established.

records.title: [InstCombine] reduce shuffles with constants to a single shuffle
records.review_note: Reassessed: constant two-source shuffle merging needs constant-lane provenance and target blend cost. Private dword immediate composition still does not represent FP constant/undef lanes.

records.title: Optimizer doesn't eliminate select with two equivalent operands
records.review_note: Reassessed: equivalent select arms require symbolic value numbering across binop/select forms with shared sums, not structural SSA equality. Current bounded mask proof has no such equivalence engine.

records.title: clang does not properly optimize xor expressions
records.review_note: Reassessed: cross-width XOR cancellation is obscured by ZEXT and shifted lane packing; exact bit demand/cast provenance remains needed beyond equal-width three-leaf synthesis.

records.title: redundant mask op could be eliminated
records.review_note: Reassessed: reuse wide masked value for a narrow masked consumer needs cross-width dominance-aware value numbering and truncation semantics. No new canonicalization proof introduced.

records.title: Some 2-vector vector select identity shuffles may be better represented as moves
records.review_note: Reassessed: partial vector identity store can narrow to untouched-range-excluding moves only with byte memory dependence and precise access semantics; register-only folds do not justify it.

records.title: Missing opt with ctlz and shifts of power of 2 constants
records.review_note: Reassessed: CLZ of shifted constant needs nonzero/count bounds or saturation at width. The motivating8387584 is not a power of two; title-based unconditional add is unsound.

records.title: [InstCombine] and-mask + conditional "sext" -> and-mask + sext
records.review_note: Reassessed: conditional variable-width sign extension needs correlated valid len/len-1/32-len and mask provenance. Fixed-count canonical-mask shifts deliberately do not cover it.

records.title: [InstCombine] Dropping pointless masking before right shift
records.review_note: Reassessed: dropping masks before variable right shifts needs variable demanded bits and source-width tracking; fixed packed shift composition does not infer the required mask/count relation.

records.title: [InstCombine] Dropping pointless masking before left shift
records.review_note: Reassessed: variable masks before left shift can be removed or transformed only with exact demand/count and truncation facts. Arithmetic-right variants cannot use logical-shift reasoning.

records.title: InstCombine combines mul->shift into two multiplies.
records.review_note: Reassessed: multiplying a shared input twice to shorten dependencies may destroy cheap shift/rotate recognition. Retained-cost and target MUL versus shift latency remain essential.

records.title: Failure to combine rotate through a select
records.review_note: Reassessed: conditional rotate reconstruction involves select control plus one retained shift; need funnel intrinsic/count semantics and use-aware duplication cost, not private adjacent shift fusion.

records.title: Failure to optimize compare and bitwise and with same operands properly (stuck at intermediate transformation)
records.review_note: Reassessed: compare AND lowbit can use a canonical0/1 mask and complement; unrelated multiply-overflow comments are explicitly off-topic. Original phase-order/Boolean lifting scope remains deferred.

records.title: Failure to optimize tautological comparisons of comparisons to a single one
records.review_note: Reassessed: XOR of truth values requires canonicalizing equivalent zero/nonzero predicates before Boolean synthesis. Upstream closure is not local tautology coverage.

records.title: Fold smax(shuffle(x,undef,m),shuffle(y,undef,m)) -> shuffle(smax(x,y),undef,m)
records.review_note: Reassessed: integer MIN/MAX commute with common permutations, but current matcher admits only typed arithmetic/bitwise ops and no demonstrated native intrinsic/width provenance path. Extending an opcode list without a native witness would overclaim; FP/FMA/funnel and undef cases remain separate.

records.title: Failure to optimize some related bool comparisons to xor+and
records.review_note: Reassessed: relational Boolean comparisons must first canonicalize truth values and equivalent predicates; bounded packed-mask proof only proves lane shape, not Boolean truth-table minimization across CFG.

records.title: Suboptimal code for branch on ctpop(x) == 1
records.review_note: Reassessed: CTPOP==1 branch lowering can use nonzero plus lowbit test; branch versus materialized Boolean costs differ and zero must not be mistaken for one set bit. No new scalar branch selection.
