records.title: Failure to optimize simple bitwise pattern
records.review_note: Reassessed: conditional masked subtraction needs range/known-bit reasoning to replace with a masked select; signedness and negative inputs change the proposed bound.

records.title: Optimize switch wirh icmp with and
records.review_note: Reassessed: switch case grouping on a2-bit field requires proven exhaustive value range and common destinations; generic bitwise synthesis does not replace CFG switch lowering.

records.title: Failed to combine popcount(x) +  popcount(x >> 32) to popcountl(x)
records.review_note: Reassessed: two32-bit population counts of disjoint halves equal one64-bit count, but requires cast/shift source matching and target POPCNT/software cost. Deferred rather than adding an unmeasured scalar-side feature.

records.title: Unrecognized rotate patterns
records.review_note: Reassessed: mismatched64-minus-count on32-bit rotates relies on poison/defined-domain reasoning and count conversion; fixed packed shifts deliberately reject variable/out-of-range counts.

records.title: [InstCombine] try to thread binop through select-of-constants
records.review_note: Reassessed: threading shift through select constants must simplify both arms before committing; inverse select folding can otherwise oscillate indefinitely. No generic speculative distribution added.

records.title: failed to fold shift amount offset into shift of a constant, part 2
records.review_note: Reassessed: shifting an exact negative constant by offset count can move offset into the constant only with valid counts and exactness proof; does not follow from arbitrary consecutive packed shifts.

records.title: Sub-optimal code generation of two successive shuffles
records.review_note: Reassessed: byte-shuffle plus dword permutation across AVX2bitcasts needs mixed-granularity provenance and target decomposition, not equal-width128-bit PSHUFD composition.

records.title: Missed optimization: Bitwise shifts don't backpropagate knowledge about their operands
records.review_note: Reassessed: back-propagating valid shift counts is unsafe after speculative motion; LLVM poison is not immediate UB. Do not infer dominating assumptions from a later shift alone.

records.title: Shufflevector sequence not optimized to splat in middle-end
records.review_note: Reassessed: byte-pair expansion/concat splats require source-length and undef-lane provenance across multiple widths; new integer mask reasoning does not add that representation.

records.title: [InstCombine] Failure to avoid decrement for non-zero input to comparison
records.review_note: Reassessed: removing decrement from unsigned compare requires actual nonzero provenance; an unused ICMP is not an assumption in LCCC and zero is a counterexample.

records.title: Remove !IsLogical conditions in foldAndOrOfICmps()
records.review_note: Reassessed: eager AND/OR versus logical-select comparisons differ under poison/speculation; blanket deletion of IsLogical guards is not sound and no freeze model is imported.

records.title: Weaken `xor` to `or` under `nand`
records.review_note: Reassessed: XOR can weaken to OR only under a dominating NAND/no-common-bits condition, not unconditionally. Current packed canonical-mask proof establishes shape, not path disjointness.

records.title: [InstCombine] Failure to merge similar comparisons that share a common true/false condition
records.review_note: Reassessed: common-condition comparisons can select a comparison operand only with canonical guards and correct Eq/Ne relation; general PHI/control cases remain outside block-local mask folding.

records.title: [InstCombine] Failure to simplify nested selects
records.review_note: Reassessed: nested-select factoring requires matched guard/short-circuit provenance and safe eager operands. Existing memory-free packed rules do not prove scalar CFG speculation.

records.title: Nan boxing misoptimization: missing icmp combine?
records.review_note: Reassessed: NaN-box tag tests are integer interval/bitmask relations across large constants; FP classification and canonical vector masks are not substitutes for exact unsigned tag ranges.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missing fold for 'and' pattern with multiple used 'xor'
records.review_note: Reassessed: shared complemented sign masks may be canonical, but converting AND to SELECT needs Boolean provenance and retained NOT/user cost. New proof can recognize shape only; do not relax shared-producer guard.

records.title: simplify logical selects
records.review_note: Reassessed: logical-select absorption is valid for canonical Boolean values but requires actual normalized predicate identities. No new scalar select engine or whole-report coverage evidence.

records.title: [opt] Failure to recognise equivalent shuffled ops
records.review_note: Reassessed: equivalent shuffled FP operations require demanded-element search, available-value dominance and exception-aware reuse. Private equal-mask integer factoring is intentionally narrower.

records.title: Use three-operand LEA for select of constants on some x86 architectures
records.review_note: Reassessed: select constants 8/13 permit scaled LEA only with the correct condition polarity and target three-input LEA latency/size policy; 9/12 follows different predicate canonicalization. No generic LEA preference established.

records.title: Transform 31 - CTLZ into CTLZ ^ 31 on x86
records.review_note: Reassessed: discussion retracts unconditional 31-CTLZ to XOR31: LZCNT(0)=32 breaks it. A dominating nonzero fact is required, not the new lane-mask proof.

records.title: Missed optimization for C ? BSWAP(X) : 0
records.review_note: Reassessed: c ? bswap(x) : 0 is not bswap(x) for independent c/x; only the x-tested special case follows from bswap(0)=0. Discussion identifies a GCC wrong-code example; not an oracle for the general fold.

records.title: Vector bswap should be combined to shufflevector
records.review_note: Reassessed: reverse qwords plus per-qword BSWAP needs byte provenance and AVX2 lane-crossing decomposition. Four-dword private shuffle composition does not establish a two-PSHUFB implementation.

records.title: Inconsistent behaviour between using logical and bitwise `and`/`or` on `smin`/`smax`
records.review_note: Reassessed: logical versus eager signed min/max predicates require poison-aware comparison implication and canonical extrema; packed canonical-mask shape is not scalar predicate equivalence.

records.title: `(-1 + b) & x` → `select b, 0, x` should work for `!range {0, 2}` too, not just for `i1`
records.review_note: Reassessed: wider loaded Boolean requires the actual [0,2) range fact before replacing b-1 with a select mask. No inference from an arbitrary i8 load or new vector mask proof.

records.title: Select not sunk into branch on same condition
records.review_note: Reassessed: sinking select arms into branches needs edge-local substitution, side-effect legality and shared-use costing. Same-condition register-mask simplification does not rewrite CFG.

records.title: Consider reducing 64-bit shifts with clamped shift amounts to 32-bit
records.review_note: Reassessed: splitting a clamped i64 shift into i32 pieces is target-dependent and requires exact count ranges; AMDGPU quarter-rate profitability is not x86 SSE2 profitability.

records.title: [X86] Questionable codegen for shuffles + combinations
records.review_note: Reassessed: residual sign-extension after an eight-comparison OR tree is directly related to the new bounded canonical-mask proof. Current native seven-leaf mixed-Boolean seed demonstrates the mechanism, but does not reproduce the report's AVX2 shuffle/pack pipeline; original scope remains deferred, not silently upgraded.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization for icmp(constants[x]) when the range of x is implied
records.review_note: Reassessed: constant-table comparison needs dominating index range plus immutable global-load analysis and bounds. New local register transforms do not prove all indexed values below five.

records.title: Failure to fold comparison implication in and chain
records.review_note: Reassessed: a<b and b<c imply a<c for stable same-domain values, but multi-condition constraint elimination must handle undef/freeze and short-circuit evaluation. No transitive solver added.

records.title: copysign of select derived from sign comparison can fold into sign operand
records.review_note: Reassessed: ordered x<0 is not the raw sign bit for negative zero or negative NaNs. Copysign folding needs explicit FP exceptional-value assumptions; integer mask shape cannot justify it.

records.title: [DAG] Failure to fold select(x, sub(x, c), m) -> sub(x, and(c,m))
records.review_note: Reassessed: blend of x and x-C can mask the constant before ADD/SUB only with canonical full-width masks and correct operand order; constant SUB often arrives as ADD(-C). New mask proof supplies a possible prerequisite, not the blend rewrite or AVX512 predicate-width proof.

records.title: [InstCombine] `!(A & INT_MIN) && A & INT_MAX` is not folded to signed comparison with zero
records.review_note: Reassessed: exclusion of sign bit plus nonzero low bits encodes signed-positive testing, but requires scalar logical implication/known bits; upstream fix is not evidence of local coverage.

records.title: High dependency chain of shufflevector instructions
records.review_note: Reassessed: reducing recurrent two-source shuffle/PHI chains needs loop dependence and register-pressure reasoning. Discussion also questions out-of-bounds source reads; current private one-source composition is insufficient.

records.title: Simplification Comparison for `(a | b) ? (a ^ b) : (a & b)` etc. (Clang13 vs Clang trunk)
records.review_note: Reassessed: conditional AND/OR/XOR identities need zero-conditioned value equivalence and cast normalization across selects; removing upstream canonicalization safeguards is not a sound local fix.

records.title: [InstCombine][EarlyCSE] Missed optimization for not canonicalizing `select uge/ult, A, B`
records.review_note: Reassessed: complementary ULT/UGE selects need stable predicate/arm canonicalization plus dominance-aware CSE. No general scalar select GVN added by packed-mask shifts.

records.title: folds for icmp-of-sum-of-extended-i1 aren't happening in more complex code
records.review_note: Reassessed: comparisons of sext/zext Boolean sums can collapse tuple ordering only after signed narrow-result and correlated-predicate reasoning. Upstream test closure is not local implementation evidence.

records.title: Missing optimization: fold `k & c ? 0 : k & c1` to `k & !c ? 0 : c1` to remove bitmask in select arm
records.review_note: Reassessed: motivating CFG uses logical Boolean conditions rather than arbitrary integer bitmasks; the rewritten title expressions even differ in polarity. Need exact Boolean/side-effect and path proofs, not a literal arbitrary-integer identity.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missing optimization: fold `select (a != V1 & a != V2), V1, a` to `select (a == V2), V2, V1`
records.review_note: Reassessed: two excluded values can reduce a select only for stable noundef operands; discussion supplies an undef counterexample. No unconditional equality-select rewrite.

records.title: Basic checks against count-leading/trailing zeroes should be optimized
records.review_note: Reassessed: CLZ/CTZ parity replacements require precise zero results and unsigned modular arithmetic; multiplication/comparison costs differ by target. Fixed packed shift fusion is unrelated.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization: fold `((select C1, C2) | A) ^ C3` to `(select C1^C3, C2^C3) | A)`
records.review_note: Reassessed: moving XOR into select constants across OR needs disjointness of both constants and shifted a; the explicit or-disjoint proof is essential. General OR is not XOR.

records.title: [SCCP][ConstantRange] Missed optimization due to approximation of `xor` operation on ConstantRange
records.review_note: Reassessed: XOR63 of a count bounded0..50 has range13..63 when high bits are zero; known bits alone lose that bound. Needs correlated range transfer, not a blanket XOR-to-sub identity.

records.title: popcount 8-bit optimization opportunity (without HW instructions)
records.review_note: Reassessed: eight-bit software POPCNT multiply-mask-multiply requires exact input width and target MUL/immediate cost; irregular seven/four-bit variants require known-zero facts. No unmeasured universal fallback replacement.

records.title: bit-count operation fallbacks can be optimized based on mask
records.review_note: Reassessed: sparse-bit count fallbacks need mask-specific lane-count arithmetic and zero semantics for CTZ. Register mask canonicality does not synthesize these SWAR reductions.

records.title: [InstCombine] Failure to fold (and %x, (sext i1 %m)) -> (select %m, %x, 0) with multiple uses of %m
records.review_note: Reassessed: factoring shared compare masks across ANDs and ADD is an algebra/cost problem with multiple users; new proof deliberately avoids removing shared producers. No coverage from one-use packed shifts.

records.title: target emission for ctlz doesn't account for range metadata
records.review_note: Reassessed: discussion clarifies CTLZ_ZERO_UNDEF already contains the nonzero precondition; range metadata need not survive. Narrow-result legalization and LZCNT availability/cost remain missing mechanisms here.

records.title: [InstCombine] fold select of select with common argument
records.review_note: Reassessed: merging selects with common arms needs free predicate inversion and target cost, and common-arm orientation matters. Eager Boolean logic must not introduce poison from an unused condition.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization: fold select if the user of its select user indicates the condition
records.review_note: Reassessed: outer select can make an inner arm unreachable under the same condition; requires conditional-demand/path reasoning including FP payloads, not structural canonical-mask propagation.

records.title: [SimplifyCFG] Missed optimization: fold `is_power_of_2(A)` to `ctpop(A) == 1`
records.review_note: Reassessed: nonzero plus CTPOP<=1 equals CTPOP==1, but speculative software CTPOP can be expensive. Existing count observation helpers do not establish CFG speculation profitability on no-POPCNT targets.

records.title: LLVM fails to optimize emulated arithmetic right shift down to a single ashr
records.review_note: Reassessed: emulated ASHR uses sign-conditioned complement/logical shifts with one valid variable count; match needs identical input/count and signed-domain proof. New pass only combines fixed packed shifts.

records.title: LLVM fails to optimize BitScanForward loop to a single cttz instruction
records.review_note: Reassessed: bounded bit-scan loop returns width at zero; replacing with CTTZ needs zero-defined semantics and loop side-effect/exit proof. Builtin lowering alone does not recognize the loop.

records.title: Multiply by a power of 2 and ctz+shift should often be interchangeable
records.review_note: Reassessed: multiply by y&-y can trade for CTZ plus shift, but y=0 must still yield zero and full-width shift is poison in LLVM. Target MUL/CTZ costs matter; discussion rejects valueless canonicalization.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization: fold chained selects with exclusive condition but one identical arm
records.review_note: Reassessed: mutually exclusive level==0/1 selects can drop an arm only with stable conditions and path implication. Duplicate upstream classification does not establish local nested-select coverage.

records.title: Missed optimization: right shift (>>) with first operand up-cast to longer types
records.review_note: Reassessed: equal right shifts across extension widths need known upper bits, signedness and count-domain equivalence. The repaired narrow vector scalarization is correctness, not a general cross-width shift value-numbering engine.

records.title: missed fold, shuffle(shuffle(v1, m1), v2, m2) => shuffle(v1, v2, m3)
records.review_note: Reassessed: two-source float shuffle-of-shuffle composition needs demanded lane provenance and target cost. Private128-bit dword same-source shuffle matcher cannot represent this64-bit/poison pattern.

records.title: missed fold, failed to kill redundant shufflevector
records.review_note: Reassessed: replacing a shuffle operand around FNEG needs exact demanded-lane mapping and FP bit semantics; upstream VectorCombine handling does not extend local PSHUFD composition to two-source float shuffles.

records.title: [IPSCCP] Missed optimization: refine range of `select`
records.review_note: Reassessed: select(x==0,3,x) is nonzero only for stable conditions/values and needs interprocedural range transfer to remove callee branches. Packed-mask proof is intraprocedural and does not carry argument ranges.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missing fold for nested selects
records.review_note: Reassessed: Boolean decision-tree reformation needs poison-aware conditional demand and a bounded cost policy; no blanket distribution of nested selects introduced.

records.title: Failure to propogate knowledge from comparison into branches
records.review_note: Reassessed: false edge can replace an undef PHI contribution with zero under masking, but requires edge-sensitive PHI/branch reasoning and safe loads. Register-only packed transforms do not establish this CFG refinement.

records.title: Bad codegen using `@llvm.ctlz.i8/i16`
records.review_note: Reassessed: narrow CLZ legalization needs separate BSR/LZCNT and zero-defined paths; moving complements across extension must preserve width. Cross-block despeculation is explicitly problematic in discussion; packed shifts do not repair it.

records.title: [InstCombine] Optimize multiple compares using `xor`
records.review_note: Reassessed: Unicode excluded-range XOR/subtraction trick needs exact aligned constants and target conditional-compare costing; AArch64 may prefer the original. No universal three-comparison replacement.

records.title: trunc nuw x to i1 as branch/select cond implies x
records.review_note: Reassessed: trunc-nuw to i1 implies original0/1 only on defined paths; regular C truncation lacks that promise. Branch/select substitutions require carrying the flag and edge polarity.

records.title: [VectorCombine] foldShuffleToIdentity can't handle BITCAST nodes
records.review_note: Reassessed: folding identity shuffles through bitcasts needs byte-to-lane mapping, since intrinsic vector integer homes commonly use i64. Equal-width private PSHUFD composition still lacks general mixed-granularity provenance.

records.title: [LLVM] Missed optimization on boolean instructions.
records.review_note: Reassessed: arbitrary three-input lookup Boolean minimization exceeds the existing bounded expression shape; current canonical-mask traversal proves0/allones but does not synthesize an optimal truth table. No coverage from similar AND/OR/XOR opcodes.

records.title: Non-overlapping shuffle indices could use the same constant
records.review_note: Reassessed: sharing partial PSHUFB constants needs demanded-lane don't-care merging with zeroing-bit semantics and constant-pool/load costs. Poison/undef masks are not interchangeable physical bytes.

records.title: Save a comparison when checking integer is within two disjoint ranges
records.review_note: Reassessed: two disjoint intervals can become one interval minus a hole only with exact signed/unsigned boundaries and cheaper resulting predicates. General range union/intersection synthesis remains absent.

records.title: `-1 << (k + 1)` => `-2 << k` Inverted shift optimizations should incorporate offsets
records.review_note: Reassessed: folding offset into allones shift constant requires a valid k+1 domain; Z3 proving a particular POPCNT bound is not an existing compiler range fact. Trunc-nuw frontend guarantees must be represented before applying it.

records.title: [X86] shufflevector codegen regression
records.review_note: Reassessed: byte zero-interleave followed by three word permutations needs cross-granularity shuffle composition and demanded poison lanes. New packed shift pass neither combines these shuffles nor introduces SSSE3 assumptions.

records.title: Regression in InstCombine Pass: Missing Simplification of icmp with Bitwise AND and llvm.assume Condition
records.review_note: Reassessed: comparison canonicalization moves observations away from the expression named by assume; needs correlated known-bit facts attached to equivalent values. No global assume/range transport added.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed combines for `(icmp (udiv exact x1, y) (udiv exact x2, y))`
records.review_note: Reassessed: discussion corrects reproducer: UGT/ULE only mark first division exact. Same-divisor cancellation requires asymmetric exactness proof and nonzero domain, not blanket order preservation for rounded quotients.

records.title: [InstCombine] Regression in and of masked comparison fold
records.review_note: Reassessed: XOR<2 plus false low bit implies XOR==0; recognizing it requires masked comparison normalization across trunc-i1 and logical chains. Canonical-mask lane shape does not implement scalar equality-of-parts.

records.title: `shufflevector %x, <every odd byte>` should optimize to `lshr %x, @splat(8)`+`trunc`
records.review_note: Reassessed: extracting odd bytes equals word LSHR8 then trunc only with exact narrowing/deinterleave lane mapping and target costs. Fixed same-width packed shifts do not represent the512-bit narrowing shuffle.

records.title: [ValueTracking] `icmp X, C1` implies `(and X, C2) != C3`
records.review_note: Reassessed: x>65535 implies some retained high bit in mask -65521; scalar range-to-known-bit contradiction is needed. Existing local mask proof does not use dominating integer ranges.

records.title: [VectorCombine] foldShuffleOfShuffles - failure to merge nested shuffles with common operands
records.review_note: Reassessed: nested two-source FP64 shuffles sharing a/b require lane provenance across intermediate vectors and poison demands. Same-source fixed128-bit dword composition remains narrower.

records.title: [VectorCombine] foldInsExtVectorToShuffle can't handle length changing shuffles
records.review_note: Reassessed: insert/extract across different vector lengths needs width-changing shuffle costs and source/destination lane bounds. No general insert/extract vector-combine implementation introduced.

records.title: [VectorCombine] Handle shuffle of selects
records.review_note: Reassessed: distributing shuffle through selects creates up to three shuffles; at least one simplification and target total-cost improvement are needed. Full-mask proof alone does not make instruction duplication profitable.

records.title: [X86] Deoptimization of shuffle intrinsics
records.review_note: Reassessed: partially zeroing PSHUFB plus VPERMD must retain byte zero provenance while eliminating unnecessary blend; current immediate dword shuffle helper does not model mixed-byte256-bit permutations.

records.title: [InstCombine] Infer exact for lshr by cttz
records.review_note: Reassessed: x shifted by CTTZ(x) discards only known zero bits; at x=0 the full-width shift remains poison. Inferring exact is not replacing zero-defined CTTZ arbitrarily or proving all later C comparisons.

records.title: [SelectionDAG][x86] Shuffle pyramid is not eliminated
records.review_note: Reassessed: replacing only scalar reduction extract leaves a live broadcast/reduction pyramid; need demanded-result replacement or native VECREDUCE MIN/MAX legalization and SSE4.1 PHMINPOS costs. No reduction coverage from shuffle factoring.

records.title: [VectorCombine] foldShuffleOfShuffles - failure to fold shuffle(shuffle(x,y),undef) length changing masks
records.review_note: Reassessed: concatenate then interleave needs two-source length-changing permutation composition. Existing one-source same-size dword matcher cannot encode float128-to256 concatenation.

records.title: x86 missed optimization for __builtin_clz()^31
records.review_note: Reassessed: CLZ-XOR31 plus one and narrow result loses BSR opportunity through trunc/sub canonicalization. Requires zero-is-poison and exact result-width selection; repaired small-vector shift promotion does not solve scalar CLZ selection.

records.title: [VectorCombine] foldShuffleOfCastops - failure to handle unary shuffles to fold shuffle(cast(x), poison) -> cast(shuffle(x,poison))
records.review_note: Reassessed: commuting unary shuffle through casts requires correct source/destination lane counts and poison versus undef handling; unused second operand is not a matching cast. No arbitrary cast shuffle motion added.

records.title: Missed Optimization: Fold parity select (x&1 ? (x-1): (x|1) ) into x ^ 1
records.review_note: Reassessed: parity-controlled x-1/x|1 becomes XOR1 on the corresponding defined arms; needs condition-specific bit facts and wrap/poison semantics, not a generic subtraction identity.

records.title: [VectorCombine] Failure to merge duplicate new nodes
records.review_note: Reassessed: duplicate vector concat nodes during FMA merging need dominance-safe get-or-create insertion and worklist CSE. A global expression cache without dominance would be wrong.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed icmp_ne(and(x,1),0) -> trunc(x) fold
records.review_note: Reassessed: lowbit comparison to trunc-i1 is valid but changes recognition in loop idioms/bit tests and can regress consumers. Current transforms do not globally canonicalize all scalar/vector Boolean forms.

records.title: [VectorCombine] foldShuffleOfBinops - support multiple uses of shuffled binops
records.review_note: Reassessed: admitting shared shuffled binops needs retained-cost accounting and broad consumer tests. New packed rewrite retains one-use guards; removing them would repeat the cost defect highlighted by230345.

records.title: LLVM does not optimize (c & a) | (!c & b) into select %c, %a, %b
records.review_note: Reassessed: mux recognition mixing eager AND with logical selects must preserve poison/undef demand; noundef variants differ. Do not undo the deliberate poison-unsafe select-to-logic restriction.

records.title: InstCombine should fold shift of boolean zext to logic sequence
records.review_note: Reassessed: shift of zext-i1 by zext-i1 has count0/1 and comparison==1 reduces x & !y; this requires0/1 value facts, unlike the0/allones packed masks. No scalar Boolean-shift matcher added.

records.title: [InstCombine] Discuss generalizing icmp eq/ne X, 0 to trunc X to i1 using KnownBits
records.review_note: Reassessed: eq/ne-zero to trunc-i1 needs all upper bits proven zero and consumer canonicalization profitability. Canonical0/allones vector masks have the opposite representation, so cannot use this criterion.

records.title: Missed optimization: fold icmp eq (or (select A, 256, 0), zext B), 257 to and A, B
records.review_note: Reassessed: equality of disjoint select256 and zext Boolean against257 can reduce to predicate AND only with disjoint constant and0/1 facts. Arbitrary mask OR is not sufficient; upstream folding is not local evidence.

records.title: missed optimization: fold fcmp une between two sign-extracting selects to xor
records.review_note: Reassessed: comparing selected finite +1/-1 values UNE yields XOR of the original unordered comparisons. Must retain those comparisons including NaN behavior, not replace them with raw sign extraction.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed cttz nonzero fold through odd multiplication
records.review_note: Reassessed: odd modular multiplication preserves nonzero and CTZ, but branch canonicalization tests x while count observes3*x. Needs equivalent nonzero/range facts across CFG, not packed adjacent-shift fusion.

records.title: [VectorCombine] Compose nested fixed shuffles through bitcasts
records.review_note: Reassessed: ONNX unpack hierarchy spans byte/word/dword bitcasts before ASHR24 and conversion/FMA. New canonical-mask proof does not infer arbitrary byte provenance or sign-widening through mixed shuffles.

records.title: [InstCombine] Fold equality with self-dependent select to constant set membership
records.review_note: Reassessed: equality with a sign-conditioned constant select can reduce to set membership when each constant satisfies its associated sign branch; needs stable SSA signed facts and profitable scalar compare selection.

records.title: [VectorCombine] foldShuffleOfBinops credits inner shuffles that remain after the fold
records.review_note: Reassessed: retained inner shuffle users must remain in post-fold cost. Current private-use guards deliberately avoid that defect; prevention is not implementation of the original general multi-use folding scope.

records.title: [AggressiveInstCombine] Split cttz/ctlz fold misses the half-word pattern when zero has a defined result
records.review_note: Reassessed: split half-word CLZ/CTZ needs explicit whole-zero result32 rather than native wide result64; also separates PHI-to-select threshold from intrinsic folding. No unconditional wide-count substitution.

records.title: [InstCombine] Missed simplification through a shared select condition
records.review_note: Reassessed: same-condition selected pointer/GEP offsets need use-local path simplification despite shared nodes and exact inbounds provenance. Register mask proof neither rewrites shared pointers nor licenses null-based GEP speculation.

review_method: Manual source-specific review of bounded prose/code/discussion excerpts from collected original GitHub bodies and accessible conversation comments. Not a full-discussion, linked-reproducer, PR-diff or external-proof audit.
